For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: May 15th, 2022 - November 2nd, 2022 
  • Number of Frames: 41,232 frames 
  • Resolution: 16 centimetre 
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup) 
  • Camera(s): Vexcel UltraCam X and Vexcel UltraCam Eagle frame-based 

For more information on the North Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (NWOOP) 2022 please see the main NWOOP 2022 GeoHub record.
